qualification.details: Project Manager: Ph.D. or equivalent in the appropriate branch with a very good academic record throughout. OR M.Tech./M.S. or equivalent qualification in an appropriate discipline with a minimum of 02 years of post-qualification experience in Teaching/Research/Industrial/Design in an organization/Industry of repute. OR B.Tech./B.E./M.Sc./MBA or equivalent in an appropriate discipline with a minimum of 04 years of post-qualification experience in teaching/research/Industrial in an organization/Industry of repute. The percentage/grade points with respect to the academic qualifications will be a minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from Graduation onwards and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Manager recruitment is 25th August 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Project Manager position by IIT Gandhinagar in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Manager role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a Ph.D. or equivalent, or M.Tech./M.S. with 2 years of experience, or B.Tech./B.E./M.Sc./MBA with 4 years of experience in a relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Manager position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Project Manager post will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 1,25,000.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the notification, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST category candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for IIT Gandhinagar Project Manager jobs?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Manager recruitment is entirely online. Candidates must apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Project Manager positions are offered on a contractual basis, meaning it is a contractual job opportunity.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.answer: The provided data does not specify age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any applicable age relaxation policies.
